units.poolKey: COMBINATION C4: a low rung on a working approach
units.spine: The road here is sound and in use. The place it serves is poor.

units.poolKey: INCOME MIX: one source carries the town
units.spine: One trade carries this place. What every other household here lives on comes out of that trade.

units.poolKey: TRADE PROFILE: exports and imports both present
units.spine: Goods leave here and goods come in, and the same carts do both. More kinds of goods go out than come back.
Warmholz sends out several kinds of goods, and the loss of any one of them would not end the trade.
Enough is grown and grazed here to feed Warmholz, with a little over.
Salt is worked in Warmholz and none of it is raised here. The salt itself is bought in, and the buying is part of the craft.
